text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back from training, we stop by the shopping district…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, a raffle… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's weird, I'm sure I had a ticket in my pocket… Is it in my bag, then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan starts fumbling around, checking her pockets.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's in my phone case! I bought a new one for New Year's! I just slipped it between the case and my phone, and—whoa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! My phooooone!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's a little cracked…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Nooo…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: U-um… Do you wanna try the raffle?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: All right! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give the lever a powerful spin on Tosen Jordan's behalf!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Holy crap! That's amazing, Trainer! You got the grand prize!
choice_data_list: Looks like it was worth getting the ticket out!
Looks like it was worth getting the ticket out!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You can say that again! Maybe we got lucky because my phone broke!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: My phone… broke…
choice_data_list: For the grand prize! What a trade!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Sure.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's a coupon for a hot spring getaway, right? Hehe, wonder who I should take…
choice_data_list: You have plenty of friends to pick from.
You have plenty of friends to pick from.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right?! How am I supposed to choose just one person? I want to go with everyone, but I'm broke!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should just sell the tickets and take everyone to karaoke…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I was just thinking about how you're the one who actually won.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …It looks like there's ages left before it expires, anyway. Guess I'll take my sweet time to think about who to bring.
choice_data_list: Well, I hope you have a good time when you do!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're really dumb too. You should be making a case for yourself right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You could say it's only fair because you won it or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, that looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like them? I love them!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Is that right? Glad to hear it! Here's your prize!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. All right, a carrot hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I hate it when you give me that face… Like you're treating me like I'm a little kid. Ughhh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says that, but her tail is up and wagging quickly. It looks like she's delighted to have won first prize.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Nicely done! Look, your trainer got the second prize!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Trainer!
choice_data_list: It's a whole cardboard box full of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! Awesome, we can eat ourselves sick!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Who should I call?! City, of course. And Palmer and Helios—all the regulars! Oh, I should hook Tickezo up too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ohh, this is gonna be so much fun!
choice_data_list: I'm glad you're feeling better now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That's just like you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Here, give me your hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She places a single carrot in my palm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …That's your share. Don't waste it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since she was nice enough to give me a carrot, I decide to cook it up and eat it within the day.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A single carrot…
choice_data_list: Not the best, but… it's something.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's whatever. If I had tried, I probably wouldn't have gotten anything, so…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't forget your prize!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's in this bag? …Wait, carrot chips?
choice_data_list: I made them with the carrot from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …You did?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haha, oh my gosh, they're all totally different sizes. C'mon, at least make them match.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll take 'em.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Forget about it. I wonder if I can get my phone fixed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I think there was some insurance or something…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I leave the shopping district with a dispirited Tosen Jordan.
